messages:
maya: Hey folks — found a weird state in the Role Composition wizard when creating a composite role. After composing two scoped roles the UI shows "scope: null" on the preview and the created role ends up missing route entitlements.

alan: ugh. can you repro reliably? on prod or staging?

maya: repro on staging. steps: add role A (routes: read:/models/*), add role B (routes: invoke:/projects/*), compose, preview shows both routes but scope becomes null after save.

priya: do we have server-side validation? sounds like a serialization bug between frontend shape and API payload.

jon: quick glance at the API — the createRole mutation expects `scopes: string[]` but the wizard sends `scopeExpressions: [{path, verbs}]`. We have a mapper but it returns `null` when verbs are empty array.

samira: that mapper existed for the old scope editor. probably missed the composite path. +1 for adding a defensive validation on the API to reject nulls.

maya: worth noting: this only happens when one of the composed roles is an empty-implicit-role (no explicit verbs) — UI still shows expected preview because it merges locally, but mapper collapses it to null.

alan: ok plan: (1) temporary revert: disable compose button when any sub-role has implicit-empty verbs; (2) backend: strict validation and a small migration to fill missing scopes with explicit empty-set; (3) unit test coverage for mapper.

jon: I'll open a PR for server-side validation + tests. Suggest payload validation error code `INVALID_SCOPE_SHAPE` so console can surface inline.

priya: console UX: instead of full revert, show inline banner: "One of the selected roles has implicit permissions — click to preview explicit scope" with a link to expand. less disruptive for power users.

maya: agree. can we also add a telemetry event when Compose is clicked with implicit roles so we can measure how many affected?

samira: yes — add `rbac.compose_attempt` with properties: `has_implicit_subroles: boolean`, `num_subroles: int`, `payload_shape_version: string`. keep obfuscated route lists.

alan: question for rollout: is this safe to ship to prod quickly? server validation first, then UI change. validation will return 400 so we need graceful error handling in console to avoid breaking flows.

jon: I'll land validation on staging behind a feature flag and add an integration test for the console error path.

maya: timeline? we prefer patch in next deploy window (tomorrow morning).

jon: PR by EOD, flag-enabled deploy to staging tomorrow AM, telemetry for a week, then prod flip if metrics look ok.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: branch jon/rbac-scope-validation -> staging (canary 10%). ETA 08:12 UTC. :rocket:

priya: followups: update docs for role composition API (example payload), and add a short note in release notes about validation error code.

maya: thanks everyone — leaving an action list in the thread for owners.
